theme_strategy: Swiss Culinary Brutalism - Merging High-Contrast Operations with Organic Restaurant Tones. Light mode preferred for POS/Kitchen visibility, with dense data.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive dashboard stats and section headers. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean legibility for tables, logs, and form inputs.

data_and_numbers.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all prices (€), stock quantities, clock-in times, and geolocation coords. Tabular lining ensures numbers align perfectly in lists.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy merged with High-Contrast Swiss

primary.description: Deep Forest Green for primary actions (Clock-in, Save)

secondary.description: Warm sand/stone for secondary cards and inactive states

destructive.description: Terracotta/Brick Red for low stock, clock-out, delete actions

accent.description: Ochre/Mustard for pending statuses or consumption alerts

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton for this POS system.
visual_enhancers.cards: border-collapse style. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-border), NO shadows. Sharp edges (radius: 0 or max 4px).
visual_enhancers.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. If content scrolls under, use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 saturate-150 border-b border-border).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to remove digital flatness, feeling more like a printed receipt or menu.

grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics).
grids.desktop: grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for deep operational views.
grids.gap: gap-1 (to create 1px border grid lines) or gap-4 for standard bento.

spans.list: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Live orders, Low stock alerts)

layouts.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for back-office (Staff, Stock, Faturação, Reports). Include user profile and quick 'Picagem de Ponto' button.
layouts.dashboard_header: Store selector, current date/time (mono font), and global search.
layouts.main_content: Generous internal padding (p-8) within the main wrapper. Mobile-first responsive.
layouts.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Highlight low stock rows with light terracotta backgrounds.

component_name.Card: Use raw div with strict borders for bento grid, or customize Shadcn Card to be radius-none shadow-none border-border.
component_name.Button: Sharp corners. Hover state must translate-y-[-1px] and add a sharp shadow.
component_name.Input/Select: Shadcn. Radius-none, focus-visible:ring-primary. Use for staff consumption entry.
component_name.Badge: Use for stock status ('Baixo', 'Esgotado', 'OK') and Staff Role.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in-up for bento grid items.
motion.clock_in: Use a meaningful micro-interaction for geolocated clock-in (e.g., a radar sweep animation turning green upon validation).

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard compliant. Dark green and Terracotta on bone-white have excellent contrast.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY for all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='btn-clock-in', data-testid='input-stock-qty').

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional UI.
media.maps: react-map-gl (Mapbox) or simple SVG radar animation for Geolocation validation.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Recharts for daily sales and staff consumption trends.

staff_portraits.description: Portraits of chefs and restaurant staff.

restaurant_interior.description: Modern European restaurant interior for brand feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Portuguese (PT) for all text (e.g., 'Controlo de Stock', 'Picagem de Ponto', 'Faturação').
Customize tailwind.config.js to include the custom color palette (Bone White, Deep Forest Green, Terracotta).
Set --radius to 0 in index.css for sharp, brutalist POS UI.
Implement a Map/Radar UI for the 'Picagem de Ponto' (Clock In) feature to visualize the geolocation radius.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Align content left, align numbers right.
Use standard HTML inputs customized via Tailwind for forms to maintain the technical look, but use Shadcn for complex interactions (Dialog, Select, Tabs).
Ensure ALL buttons and inputs have `data-testid` attributes.
Ensure .js/.jsx extensions are used for React components, not .tsx.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. (For this app, use SHARP buttons).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
